name: Hades
subtitle: The Unseen One
description: Curse enemies with debuffs and lockouts and drag them to their afterlife.
lore: Lord of the Olympian underworld, Hades is normally a cold, implacable deity. Indeed, for a time, even the upheaval of the Shattering scarcely drew his attention. Now that he has decided to act, he dithers over whether the invitation to join Osiris’s “Shadow Council” of underworlds is the proper course. This uncharacteristic indecision threatens to distract him from other vital concerns…
divinity_generator: Gain [40] Divinity when inflicting damage to enemies under [Curse].

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Awaken the ability: Torment of Souls
Ignore RES +20%, Turn Meter Multiplier +20%, DMG Multiplier +30%
Attunement Multiplier +50%, Armor Multiplier +30%, Weapon Multiplier +30%

skills.name: Lethe’s Lament
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy with a 30% chance to place [mechanic:sleep] for 1 turn.
skills.awakening_bonus: Also has a 80% chance to increase the cooldown of the enemy’s core ability by 2 turns if they are under [Curse].

skills.name: Torment of Souls
skills.description: Attack all enemies with a 75% chance to place [mechanic:despair] for 1 turn. Also places [mechanic:lock-ultimate] for 1 turn on enemies under [Curse].
skills.awakening_bonus: Will not weak hit enemies under [Curse].

skills.name: Charon Awaits
skills.description: At the start of this hero’s turn, place [mechanic:curse-ii] for 1 turn on the enemy with the Highest ATK. When an enemy under [Curse] is defeated, place [mechanic:curse-ii] for 1 turn on a living enemy with the Highest ATK. [mechanic:curse-ii] cannot be dispelled or resisted.
skills.awakening_bonus: At the end of this hero’s turn place [Corrupt], [Charm], [Hex II] or [RES Down II] for 1 turn on targets under [Curse II].

skills.name: Lethe’s Lamen
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy 270%ATK with a 30% chance to place [mechanic:sleep] for 1 turn.
skills.awakening_bonus: Also has a 80% chance to increase the cooldown of the enemy’s core ability by 2 turns if they are under [Curse].

skills.name: Misery of Archon
skills.description: Attack all enemies 2 times. The first attack will Decrease the target’s Turn Meter by 20%. The second attack will place [mechanic:spd-down-ii] for 2 turns. Also places [mechanic:init-down-ii] for 2 turns on enemies under [Curse].

imprint_passive: At the start of this hero’s turn, has a 50% chance to place [Curse II] for 1 turn on the enemy with the Highest ATK. When an enemy under [Curse] is defeated, place [Curse II] for 1 turn on a living enemy with the Highest ATK. [Curse II] cannot be dispelled or resisted.
